variantDetails.cosyOfficial: Small official 0.5B model; a starting point for the CosyVoice engine. The studio does not guarantee a VRAM figure.
variantDetails.cosyGguf: cstr conversion: Q4_K talker and Q8_0 flow. Approximately 745 MB of weights for preset voices; cloning also requires the tokenizer and speaker encoder. Requires the compatible CrispASR engine.
variantDetails.fishFp8: drbaph FP8 conversion with BF16 activations. Requires a specific FP8Linear loader; the official engine alone is insufficient. Fish Audio Research license.
variantDetails.fishGguf: rodrigomt Q6_K conversion, approximately 4.3 GB file size. Requires the experimental community s2.cpp engine. Fish Audio Research license.
variantDetails.fishGgufSmall: rodrigomt Q4_K_M conversion, approximately 3.4 GB file size, with stronger quantization. Requires experimental s2.cpp; compare quality with Q6_K. Fish Audio Research license.
variantDetails.fishFull: Official BF16 weights. Fish recommends 24 GB for S2 Pro; prefer a smaller variant with 16 GB. Fish Audio Research license.
variantDetails.qwenSmall: Official Base 0.6B BF16 voice-cloning model, with fewer parameters than 1.7B. Plan one loaded model and one subtitle at a time during integration.
variantDetails.qwenFull: Official Base 1.7B BF16 voice-cloning model. Complete engine memory remains to be measured; 0.6B and the GGUF profile are lighter alternatives.
variantDetails.qwenGguf: HaujetZhao project: Q5_K talker, Q8_0 predictor and ONNX FP16 components. Converted from official weights; the complete hybrid engine is needed, rather than opening one GGUF in an LLM player.
variantDetails.phase6Gguf: audio.cpp 0.9.1: GGUF Q8_0 weights, Vulkan on the selected GPU or CPU. Automatic mode prefers a discrete GPU. Model files also include the speech codec.
variantDetails.dramaGenerationHint: Drama 3 FP8: memory-mapped experts without a full pinned RAM copy; GPU cache capped at 4 GiB, BF16 layers and FP32 codec. Recommended: NVIDIA 16 GB + 64 GB RAM. Guards: 48 GiB usable RAM, 24 GiB available RAM and 12 GiB free VRAM. An SSD is recommended; disk access may slow generation. About 40.1 GB of models; allow 60 GB free disk for the first install. First load takes time; slower than S2. No CPU fallback.
variantDetails.voxcpmProfile: VoxCPM2 2B · BF16 on NVIDIA CUDA 12.8, FP32 on CPU. Supports French and Japanese. Transcript-free reference in cross-language mode; exact transcript for continuation. Moods and accents are prompt directions, with no guaranteed result.
variantDetails.chatterboxProfile: Chatterbox Multilingual V3 · 500M · explicit French language, including with a Japanese reference. Transcript-free reference, CFG 0 to limit language leakage. Perth audio watermark preserved. NVIDIA CUDA 12.8 or CPU.

isolateRegionHint: Replaces this track’s regions with listening limited to the selection. Undo with Ctrl+Z.
regionSaved: Region saved. Track settings retain priority.
regionGainHint: Heard volume = master × track × region volume. Muted tracks or tracks excluded by solo remain silent. Edited exports of separated tracks include track gain and regions; solo and master volume are player settings.
modelStorageSizeHint: Sum of file sizes in the folder, without following symbolic links or junctions. Actual allocated disk space may differ.
ttsModelHint: Local speech synthesis from text and a voice reference. Official 0.5B RL weights; FP16 on CUDA, FP32 on CPU. One AI task at a time.
ttsInstallCuda: Install CUDA 12.8 for NVIDIA RTX GPUs (including RTX 5060 Ti)
ttsLocalHint: Each generation creates a new take without overwriting older ones. The model unloads afterwards to release VRAM. WAV listening is independent from video playback.

phase6Profiles: 16 GB profiles: start with Qwen3-TTS 0.6B GGUF. Only one engine loads at a time. Actual VRAM depends on text and reference; these profiles still need validation on your RTX.
phase6Gguf: audio.cpp 0.9.1: GGUF Q8_0 weights, Vulkan on the selected GPU or CPU. Automatic mode prefers a discrete GPU. Model files also include the speech codec.
phase6Fp8: FP8 E4M3 weights and BF16 activations with the Fish loader. Requires CUDA 12.8, an NVIDIA BF16 GPU and at least 12 GiB free VRAM. Close other AI applications. Isolated Python installation.
phase6FishLicense: Fish Audio Research License: non-commercial use; commercial use requires a separate license.
phase6ModelSize: model only; engine and dependencies are additional
dubbingMixHint: Enables dubbing and mutes the replacement track chosen above, plus original audio. Other separated tracks remain audible.
exportMkvHint: Copies the original video without re-encoding. The studio mix becomes the default audio track; subtitles remain selectable in your player.
mixNaturalLength: Automatic fitting is active: long voices are sped up without changing pitch to end by their dialogue’s end or the next take’s start. Shorter voices keep their duration. Playback and export share the same adjustment; original takes are retained.
mixFitSummary: {{adjusted}} automatically fitted takes. Listen to acceleration above 1.5× and consider a shorter translation.
mixReview: Review: {{missing}} lines without voices, {{stale}} takes changed since generation, {{fast}} accelerations above 1.5×, {{conflicts}} conflicting slots (omitted from the mix).
mixAcceptReview: Export this edit despite missing or unreviewed lines
mixOriginalWarning: Original voices are audible in the mix. Use “Prepare dubbing mix” to mute them.
mixNoStems: To keep music and effects without the original voices, run separation in Audio first.
mixExportLevels: Export uses the mixer’s mutes, solos, gains and regions. Player monitoring volume does not affect export. Peaks above 0 dB are clipped: lower levels if needed.

mkv.includeOriginal: Also keep the original audio track unchanged

ttsFishHint: Fish requires reference audio and an exact transcript of the words spoken in it, in the original language. Japanese audio needs Japanese text, even for French dubbing. Use “Transcribe automatically” to prepare it. Drama 3 always receives the target language, including with Auto accent; the reference transcript stays in its original language.
asrHint: Whisper small multilingual · local CPU inference · 181 MiB model downloaded on first use into your configured model folder. No audio is uploaded.
asrReviewHint: The transcript stays in the spoken language. Listen to the reference and check the proposed text; correct names and missing words before dubbing.
asrDubReviewHint: Review and correct the reference transcript here before generation. It must match the audio exactly, in its original language.
asrCurrentHint: If the original SRT is missing, open “Manage characters and references”, select the character, then “Extract this line” and “Transcribe automatically”. Use that reference for dubbing.
dubbingDragHint: Drag to move the voice. Shift: snap. Arrow keys: 10 ms; Shift + arrows: 1 ms. Escape: cancel.
dubbingOffsetHint: Negative: earlier voice; positive: later. Placement applies to playback and export. Subtitles and the original WAV keep their timings.
dubbingDurationHint: Drag the right edge or enter a duration within the displayed bounds. The edge stops at the next voice, video end and 120 s. Moving preserves audible duration and stops before other voices. Listen to large changes.
dubbingResizeHint: Drag this edge to lengthen or shorten the voice while preserving pitch.
ttsMoodHint: Acting directions for CosyVoice3, Fish S2, Drama 3 and VoxCPM2. Detailed intentions are interpreted on a best-effort basis, with no guaranteed result: compare takes. Subtitle text stays the same.
ttsMoodUnsupported: The integrated Qwen3-TTS Base variants do not expose mood control. Use CosyVoice3, Fish S2 or Drama 3 for this setting.
ttsCosyMoodHint: Choosing a mood or accent activates CosyVoice3 instruction mode. The reference still guides the voice, but its intonation cues are used differently from exact-transcript mode; acting may change or become more neutral.
timelineZoomHint: Ctrl + wheel: zoom at pointer · Ctrl + + / −: zoom at playhead · Shift + Z: fit timeline
timelineZoomLimitedHint: View limited to 2 minutes to preserve playback performance · Ctrl + wheel or Ctrl + + / −: zoom · Shift + Z: limited view around playback
lipsHint: Local CPU analysis of visible mouth activity. Choose a short shot with a visible mouth. Review the proposed voice start and duration before applying.
lipsNeedsTake: Generate and select a dubbing take for this line first.
lipsSelectHint: Drag a rectangle around the mouth with a small skin margin. Exclude eyes and subtitles. Adjust coordinates if needed. For a moving head or shot change, use a shorter analysis window.
lipsChart: Mouth activity and proposed voice slot
lipsScore: Visual match: {{before}} → {{after}} / 100. This is a matching indicator, not a calibrated probability.
lipsLowActivity: Little visible movement in the selected region. Check that it contains the mouth.
lipsUnstableShot: The region changes strongly: shot cut, moving head or a tight rectangle. Shorten the window and review the result.
lipsAmbiguous: Several alignments have similar scores. Review the proposal in playback.
lipsWeakMatch: Weak correspondence between visible activity and voice. Manual alignment may work better.
lipsAcceptWeak: I reviewed this uncertain alignment and want to apply it.
lipsStale: The project or take changed. Analyze again before applying.
lipsManualHint: Offset and duration remain editable on the timeline. Ctrl+Z undoes the application. Playback and MKV export share the adjustment.
lipsVideoEditHint: Alignment adjusts the audio. Generating new mouth images requires a separate video engine; it is not integrated yet. See the Lip alignment guide in the GitHub repository.
lipsChartLegend: Green: mouth activity · Purple: proposed voice and slot
inpaintModelHint: FP16 UNet, FP32 VAE, one frame at a time and a 256 × 256 face. CUDA 12.8 for NVIDIA GPUs including the RTX 5060 Ti. Models use the configured storage directory.
inpaintRuntimeSize: Additional Python/CUDA runtime; allow about 14 GB for a first installation
inpaintHint: Generate mouth images from the selected take at its current start and duration. Each result is an independent variant; review it before enabling.
inpaintStyleHint: These profiles adjust blending with the same model. The model is not specialized for every drawing style; review teeth, contours and colors.
inpaintRegionHint: On the first frame, draw the whole face including eyes, nose and chin. Then draw the mouth inside it. Green: face; purple: blended region. Mask coordinates are relative to the face.
inpaintTrack: Simple movement from start to end
inpaintTrackHint: Set the upper-left face position at the end of the shot. Translation is interpolated; this does not track rotation, zoom or shot changes.
inpaintNoCuda: No CUDA GPU available. Check the NVIDIA driver and repair the runtime. No automatic CPU fallback.
inpaintLimits: One frontal, visible face in a 0.2–10 second shot. Output is 25 fps. Rendering may take several minutes and releases VRAM on completion.
inpaintStale: The take or its timing changed. Disable this variant or generate it again before exporting.
inpaintExportHint: Enabled variants appear in playback and MKV export. Originals stay intact; Ctrl+Z undoes activation.
inpaintEncodeHint: Retouched images require H.264 video re-encoding (CRF 18). Uncheck to export the original video without these retouches.
inpaintPreviewFailed: Retouched clip unavailable: original video remains visible. Check the file in the Lips panel.
replacementTrack: Track to replace in the dubbing mix
audioSourceHint: The reference includes the selected track’s edited portions, before its fader and M/S controls. “Prepare dubbing mix” mutes the replacement track and original audio; the other separated tracks remain audible.
transferHint: Uses Start / End above (10 ms to 60 s). Copy adds audio to the destination; move adds it and silences the source; swap exchanges both ranges. Destination levels and regions apply afterwards.
transferUndoHint: Original WAV files are preserved. Ctrl+Z undoes the whole operation. The waveform shows the original file; coloured bands mark transferred portions.
inpaintTimeoutHint: You can cancel processing in Jobs.
dramaHint: The FP8 profile with experts in RAM is integrated. The other variants below remain informational catalogue entries.
dramaSize: Weights + codec: {{size}} GiB (file size, not VRAM)
dramaCandidate: Candidate for 16 GB VRAM + 64 GB RAM: experts offloaded to RAM; RTX 5060 Ti compatibility and speed unmeasured.
dramaOfficial: The official runtime requires at least 48 GB VRAM and NVIDIA CUDA on Linux/WSL. It exceeds a 16 GB card; our S2 FP8 loader cannot load Drama 3.
dramaInt4: Community W4A16 quantization with MoE routing and BF16 decoding. Total weights exceed 16 GB; this is neither GGUF nor compatible with audio.cpp. SGLang-Omni is not integrated.
dramaOffload: Community conversion: FP8 experts kept in RAM with a GPU cache. The author reports NVIDIA GPUs ≥ 8 GB and about 48 GB system RAM. FP8 is a candidate for 16 GB VRAM + 64 GB RAM, not a qualification on your GPU.
dramaW6: Community W6A8 conversion with experts in RAM, about 40 GB system RAM according to its author. Requires a specific ComfyUI loader; French quality and speed not evaluated in the studio.
dramaW4: Community W4A8 conversion, about 32 GB RAM according to its author. The author reports more silent generations with real references; prefer FP8 when RAM permits.
dramaLicense: Fish Audio Community License 1.0 · sources checked on 2026-10-16
dramaNoGguf: Drama 3 is available in FP8 with experts in RAM. No Drama 3 GGUF engine is integrated.
dramaGenerationHint: Drama 3 FP8: memory-mapped experts without a full pinned RAM copy; GPU cache capped at 4 GiB, BF16 layers and FP32 codec. Recommended: NVIDIA 16 GB + 64 GB RAM. Guards: 48 GiB usable RAM, 24 GiB available RAM and 12 GiB free VRAM. An SSD is recommended; disk access may slow generation. About 40.1 GB of models; allow 60 GB free disk for the first install. First load takes time; slower than S2. No CPU fallback.
dramaIntegrated: FP8 integrated · generation with experts in RAM
phase6FishLicenseDrama: Drama 3 · Fish Audio Community License 1.0 · Built with Fish Audio
timelineSelectionTrackMuted: Track muted: its speaker control still takes priority.
dramaInstallHelp: Automatic installation into your configured model storage folder. No separate ComfyUI installation is needed. See Processing for progress.
dramaSpaceMissing: Not enough space: free about {{missing}} GiB more or change model storage in Settings.
dramaSpaceDetails: Remaining weights: {{models}} GiB · Archives to download: {{downloads}} GiB · Remaining extraction reserve: {{runtime}} GiB · Margin: {{margin}} GiB.
dramaSpaceError: Cannot check storage. Verify that the drive is connected, then retry.
dramaSpaceHint: Local check without downloads. Conservative estimate includes dependencies and extraction, deducting existing files. Space is checked again when starting; file integrity is still checked during installation.
ttsImportReferenceHint: WAV, MP3, FLAC, M4A, OGG, AAC or Opus. Audition the source and choose start and end before copying the excerpt into the project (1 to 20 seconds). Prefer clear solo speech without music.
ttsAccentHint: Pronunciation instruction for CosyVoice3, Fish S2 and Drama 3; regional accents are not guaranteed. A clear French reference is the most reliable way to reduce Japanese accent transfer. CosyVoice3 uses instruction mode without reference transcription.
ttsAccentUnsupported: This engine or target language does not yet support accent selection in the studio.
batchAllTranslated: All translated lines in the project
batchForce: Force a new take, even when an up-to-date take exists
batchPolicyHint: Without forcing, current selected takes are kept. Each successful generation creates and selects a new take; previous takes remain available. An imported reference is shared; character defaults and current-line audio are resolved for each line. Generation runs sequentially on the chosen device.
batchPreview: {{ready}} to generate · {{existing}} already dubbed · {{untranslated}} untranslated · {{blocked}} excluded (configuration/reference) · {{unapproved}} unapproved excluded · {{approved}} approved excluded
batchJobSummary: {{completed}} / {{total}} processed · {{succeeded}} succeeded · {{failed}} failed · {{skipped}} excluded or already available
referenceSourcePreview: Listen to the reference source file
referenceRangeHint: Selected duration: {{seconds}} s. Choose between 1 and 20 seconds within the file.
translationReviewHint: Translation approval is independent of voice-take approval. Editing the source, translation or language removes approval.
ttsBatchLocalHint: The model stays loaded for this batch and is released when it ends, is cancelled, or the engine fails. Lines are generated one at a time.
batchTranslationFilter: Translations to include in the batch
llmHint: Local proposal using neighbouring dialogue as context. Review and edit before applying. The model is released after each proposal or cancellation.
llmInstallHint: 2.33 GiB Q4_K_M model. Self-contained llama.cpp/Vulkan installation, without Python or Ollama. Supports CPU and Vulkan GPUs; select the RTX in the list. Apache 2.0 model, MIT runtime.
llmDisk: Space to reserve: {{required}} GiB · available: {{available}} GiB
llmApplyHint: Applying replaces translated text while preserving timing. Translation approval remains manual.
llmApplied: Proposal applied. Review it and approve the translation when satisfied.
editVoiceRegion: Edit a region of the selected dubbing
voiceWaveSelection: Waveform: select part of the dubbing
stretchVoiceHint: Stretch the selected region: drag this handle
voiceEditHint: Click to place the cursor or drag to select. Silence is inserted at the selection start; deleting closes the gap within this take. Drag ↔ to stretch the region while preserving pitch. Subtitles and other lines stay in place. Ctrl+Z to undo.
INVALID_VOICE_EDIT: Invalid selection or duration. Keep at least part of the take (maximum 120 s and 256 segments).
VOICE_EDIT_NO_ROOM: The edit would cross the next dubbing clip or the end of the video. Shorten it or move the next clip first.
VOICE_EDIT_FAILED: Could not prepare edited dubbing audio.
INVALID_VOICE_FADE: Fade lengths must be zero or positive and must fit within the selection.
voiceDurationLimits: Audible duration: {{duration}} ms · available maximum here: {{max}} ms (up to 120 s).
voiceTimingLimited: The saved timing exceeds its available slot or leaves too little room for its pieces. Move this take into a free interval or reduce its duration. Your edits remain recoverable.
VOICE_DURATION_OUT_OF_RANGE: This duration exceeds the available limits. Respect the displayed maximum and keep at least 1 ms per piece.
voiceTimingCommitHint: Press Enter or leave the field to apply; Escape cancels typing.
contextRegionHint: Right-click to remove this region and restore the track volume.
latent15Hint: LatentSync 1.5 at 256 px, adapted from the ShmuelRonen wrapper. Memory-saving profile for NVIDIA GPUs with 8 GB or more; isolated CUDA 12.8 runtime.
latent16Hint: LatentSync 1.6 at 512 px, adapted from the ShmuelRonen wrapper. Candidate 16 GB profile: 8-frame windows, sequential guidance and staged VAE. Official inference lists 18 GB without these adaptations; OOM safety and speed are not measured on your GPU.
latentMemoryProfile: 16 GB profile: CPU audio analysis, UNet on the selected GPU, VAE on that GPU only during single-frame encoding/decoding. Overlapping windows; smaller windows retried on the same GPU after OOM. The process exits after completion or cancellation.
latentAnimeHint: LatentSync primarily targets frontal human faces. Anime is experimental: frame the whole face and compare before activating a variant. MuseTalk remains available.
latentLimits: 0.2 to 120 seconds per dialogue, at 25 fps. Source files remain unchanged. Long takes can be slow; generation has a two-hour limit.
inpaintSequence: Independent sequence: {{start}} → {{end}} ({{seconds}} s), aligned to the dubbed voice. The main video remains unchanged; only the enabled variant overlays this interval.
inpaintDiskSpace: Available: {{available}} GiB · estimated additional requirement: {{required}} GiB (weights, dependencies, extraction and margin).
latentRuntimeSize: Shared CUDA runtime for 1.5 and 1.6; separate model weights. Installation budget below.
inpaintBatchCommonCrop: Use the displayed framing for dialogues without a crop
inpaintBatchCropWarning: Common framing does not track shot or character changes. Set dialogue-specific crops where needed; dialogues without framing are skipped.
inpaintBatchForce: Force new variants even when a current retouch exists
inpaintBatchSourceKept: One independent sequence per dialogue; the main video and existing takes stay intact. Sequential processing releases VRAM between dialogues. Cancel and resume from Processing.
inpaintBatchPlan: {{ready}} ready of {{requested}} · {{undubbed}} not dubbed · {{existing}} already retouched · {{crops}} missing crops · {{blocked}} excluded
inpaintBatchFramingHint: Set the batch options. Use the dialogue selector to frame individual dialogues for this batch. Framing from existing variants can also be reused.
inpaintBatchSaveCrop: Keep this crop for dialogue {{number}} in this batch
mcpDescription: Let an MCP-compatible AI client control the open project: editing, models, generation, playback and exports. The studio’s save, validation and undo checks still apply.
mcpConfigurationHint: Add this configuration to your MCP client and keep the studio open. The relay uses this executable; no additional Node.js or Python runtime is required. Commands wait up to 3 minutes; monitor long-running work using its job ID.
voicePlayheadIdle: Start listening to locate the sound
voiceOriginalKept: The original take is retained. Edits render into working copies; you can audition or restore the original.
voiceEditValidating: Checking the audio render before saving the edit…
voiceEditRenderFailedKept: This edit could not be rendered. The previous version and original take are retained. See diagnostics.
VOICE_EDIT_STALE: The dialogue changed during validation. Retry the edit.
faceDetectionHint: Local CPU analysis of five frames per dialogue. First use adds OpenCV and two verified small detectors (about 40 MB download). Manual and saved framing take priority.
faceReviewHint: Review framing in the dialogue selector before synchronizing. Multiple faces, shot cuts, occlusions and complex movement require manual framing. Detection does not identify the speaker.

prosody.title: Intonation transfer · Experimental
prosody.hint: Start with a take whose pronunciation you like, then use another voice as its intonation guide. Runs locally on CPU with no additional model.
prosody.limits: Approximate acoustic transfer across languages. Start at 50%. At 0% the sound stays identical. Previous takes are preserved.
prosody.create: Create a new take with this intonation

ttsCosyReferenceActingHint: To favor reference acting: choose an expressive French reference, Auto accent, Default mood and exact-transcript mode. A neutral reference can yield neutral delivery.
voxcpmGenerationHint: VoxCPM2 2B · BF16 on NVIDIA CUDA 12.8, FP32 on CPU. Supports French and Japanese. Transcript-free reference in cross-language mode; exact transcript for continuation. Moods and accents are prompt directions, with no guaranteed result.
chatterboxGenerationHint: Chatterbox Multilingual V3 · 500M · explicit French language, including with a Japanese reference. Transcript-free reference, CFG 0 to limit language leakage. Perth audio watermark preserved. NVIDIA CUDA 12.8 or CPU.
chatterboxCloneHint: This engine uses reference audio without a transcript and receives the project target language separately. French does not depend on selecting a regional accent.
chatterboxMoodHint: Named moods and regional accents are not controlled by this Chatterbox integration. Delivery depends on the reference; use an expressive French reference to limit accent transfer.
multilingualHardwareHint: Candidate profile for a 16 GB RTX. VRAM and speed depend on text and reference; RTX 5060 Ti performance is not measured. An explicitly selected GPU never silently falls back to CPU.
multilingualRuntimeHint: Python/CUDA runtime shared only by VoxCPM2 and Chatterbox, isolated from other engines. The estimate includes missing weights, archives, extraction and a margin; verified files are reused. Space is checked again before any download.

capture.title: Record with a microphone
capture.hint: Record your performance (0.15–120 s), listen, then keep it as another take. Local mono 24 kHz PCM WAV; no AI model required. The microphone stops on stop/cancel. Original takes remain intact.
capture.clipping: The signal clipped: lower the microphone level and record again.
capture.vcHint: Convert an existing take to the timbre of a character reference or imported audio file. No text is synthesised again. Take edits are included and previous takes are preserved.
capture.vcLimits: Local Chatterbox VC: 1–20 s reference (up to 10 s used by the model), 0.15–120 s take. Duration is preserved; timbre and nuances depend on reference quality. No translation or automatic accent correction. Perth audio watermark retained.
capture.convert: Create a take with this timbre
capture.vcModelHint: Official Chatterbox audio-to-audio conversion, no transcript. Approx. 0.98 GiB model, bounded audio windows limit VRAM. CUDA 12.8 or CPU; local environment shared with VoxCPM2/Chatterbox, separate from CosyVoice3. No audio upload.

llmDirectionPlaceholder: A villain says this line, using vulgar language. Keep the translated line close to the original spoken length.
llmDirectionHint: Character, register, tone, vocabulary and desired length. Available duration: {{seconds}} s. This is a soft goal: actual spoken duration depends on the voice generation. These instructions are kept on this PC for future proposals.
jobDurationHint: Active execution time (hours:minutes:seconds), excluding queue and pauses.
jobDurationUnknownHint: Duration was not recorded for this older job.
fxEmpty: Add an effect or choose a preset.
fxChainHint: Processing runs from left to right, up to 8 effects. The power button bypasses an effect without losing settings. The settings button opens its parameters and ordering controls. Apply the chain to update the rendered audio.
fxTrackHint: A whole track creates an independent local copy; a selection adds a replacement layer. Original files are kept and Ctrl+Z undoes the operation. Track gain and region volume remain adjustable after processing.
fxReplaceInMix: Enable the processed copy and mute the source track in the mix
fxVoiceSelectionHint: Effects replace the chain on the selected range. Preview the result before applying.
fxVoiceWholeHint: No range selected: effects apply to the whole voice take. Preview the result before applying.
fxWaveformHint: The waveform shows source audio; playback and exports include effects. Echo tails stay within the range duration.
meterHint: Stereo levels after gain, regions and effects, before the player's listening volume. Bars: RMS average; line: sample peak. A red indicator flags peaks at or above 0 dBFS and stays on until reset.
meterResetHint: Maximum: {{max}} dBFS · click to clear the maximum and clipping indicator
meterUnavailable: Audio metering unavailable; playback remains available.

quality.title: Generation quality
quality.voxHint: For metallic speech, try Natural: 20 steps and guidance 1.6. More steps take longer; stronger guidance may increase artifacts. Compare new takes.
quality.stepsHint: Steps control acoustic decoder computation. Detailed takes longer; it does not guarantee a better result for every voice.
quality.samplingHint: These controls change stability and voice variation. They do not change model weights or quantization. Higher does not mean better quality.
quality.chatterHint: For Japanese reference audio and French text, prefer guidance 0 to reduce accent and language leakage.
quality.referenceHint: A clean reference without music and speed close to 1× help reduce artifacts. Settings are stored with each new take; existing takes are preserved.

hints.inferenceSteps: More steps: more computation and slower generation.
hints.cfgStrength: VoxCPM2: try 1.5–1.6 for buzzing. Strong guidance may cause artifacts.
hints.temperature: Lower: less variation. Higher: more diversity, with a risk of instability.
hints.topP: Limits choices to the most likely candidates.
hints.topK: Number of retained candidates; 0 disables this filter when supported.
hints.repetitionPenalty: Reduces repetition; excessive values can distort diction.
hints.minP: Removes candidates that are too unlikely.
hints.cfgWeight: Higher values may strengthen the reference accent.
hints.exaggeration: Strengthens acting; high values may change the rhythm.

resizeWorkspaceHint: Drag or use arrow keys; Shift for larger steps. Double-click to reset.
fxChainLimit: Up to 8 effects; bypassed effects keep their settings.
fxDraftHint: These settings prepare the chain. Close this window, then apply the effects to update the rendered audio.
translationApproveSelectionHint: Approve {{count}} pending translation(s) among checked lines, including those hidden by filters. Empty translations are skipped.
translationUnapproveSelectionHint: Withdraw {{count}} approval(s) among checked lines, including those hidden by filters.
characterSampleHint: Up to 20 seconds, including track edits, before its global fader and mute.
characterRegisterHint: Acoustic register measured on the excerpt; it does not determine gender.
characterPortraitProposal: Proposed thumbnail: a face on screen does not establish who is speaking.
characterPortraitAuto: Propose a face crop (anime or live action)
characterSimilarityHint: Groups compare thumbnail images. Review images and voices before merging; merging is never automatic.
characterMergeHint: Dialogues are reassigned to this profile. Existing references and voice takes are retained. Choose one default reference, several to combine, or none to keep the current default. Review transcripts after trimming.
speakerGuideHint: Matches this character’s references and proposes only matching dialogues. Speech/music/effects separation is rerun separately from the audio selection.
speakerReplaceAssigned: Allow reassignment of already assigned dialogues in this scope
localSeparationHint: Process 0.1–60 seconds of the chosen edited track with Bandit. Audition all three results before applying. Video and source track files stay intact.
localSeparationStemsRequired: Prepare the Speech, Music and Effects tracks with full separation first.
localSeparationReview: Preview only: no changes applied. For Original, all three regions are replaced. For a stem, its region is replaced and the other two components are added to their tracks.
localSeparationApplied: Separation applied to this interval. Undo with Ctrl+Z.
localSeparationStale: Tracks changed after this preview. Run separation again before applying.
localIdentifyAfter: Identify voices in this section again
speakerNoMatches: No sufficiently confident voice matches. Try another reference or threshold.

library.title: Character voice library
library.hint: Combine excerpts of this character, then generate French phrases for listening and approval. Dialogue takes are retained.
library.sourceDuration: {{seconds}} s selected · 5–20 s total, up to 16 excerpts
library.phraseHint: Choose phrases and delivery. Review diction, timbre and accent before approval. A French direction does not guarantee an accent.
library.installVox: Install or check VoxCPM2 in Models
library.preserveHint: Every lot adds new takes for approval. The model stays loaded for the lot, then is released at completion or cancellation. Original files are retained.
library.actualTranscript: Actual spoken text · editing withdraws approval
library.onlyApproved: Only approved phrases may be used. In a lot, each character uses its own default reference. Manage them in Characters → Voice library.
library.guideNeedsVoice: Choose a timbre reference separate from the current dialogue, such as an approved French phrase.
library.guideHint: The reference provides the voice; the original dialogue provides the guide. Each line in a lot uses its own excerpt.
library.guideHybridHint: Experimental: the engine receives the voice reference and the dialogue with its original transcript. The guide can also transfer its accent or timbre. Accent and mood instructions are disabled; audition the result.
library.guideStyleHint: Local pause, pitch-variation and energy analysis becomes delivery directions. No Praat resynthesis or Japanese audio mixing. Exact emotion and syllabic timing are not guaranteed.
library.guideInputMissing: The guide requires at least one second. Two-input mode also requires the original transcript.
library.frenchFidelityHint: This button enables Ultimate / Hi-Fi with actual French speech and its exact transcript. It removes separate accent, mood and guide instructions. It does not force an accent: switch back to Standard under Cloning mode.
library.voxContinuationHint: VoxCPM2 reference fidelity: audio and transcript provide timbre, language and acting. Separate accent/mood directions are not applied in this mode. Choose an approved French reference with the intended performance.
library.shortContext: Both text and reference are very short, which can destabilize the accent. Try a clean 5–20 second French reference and audition the new take.
library.voxHiFiOption: Ultimate Cloning / Hi-Fi on · exact transcript
library.voxStandardHint: Standard cloning: start here for Japanese → French when the target accent matters most. The reference guides timbre; accent and mood instructions remain available, without a guaranteed outcome.
library.voxHiFiHint: Ultimate / Hi-Fi continues the reference audio using its exact transcript. It can copy the source accent and pronunciation habits. With Japanese reference speech, start with Standard to favor French. Separate accent/mood instructions do not apply in this mode.
library.voxHybridHint: The two-audio guide also uses Ultimate / Hi-Fi continuation and may transfer the Japanese guide accent. Choosing Standard removes this hybrid guide.

speakerSuggest.title: Character suggested by voice
speakerSuggest.noReferences: Add original character voice excerpts for comparison. Synthesized phrases are not used for identification.
speakerSuggest.failed: Matching failed. Check references and retry.
speakerSuggest.stale: This comparison is stale. Refresh before choosing.
speakerSuggest.tooShort: Too little speech or no speech: choose the character manually.
speakerSuggest.uncertain: Uncertain match: listen and review before accepting.
speakerSuggest.hint: CPU analysis of original voice references. No assignment changes without approval; takes are retained.

ttsQwenRecovered: Qwen3: recovered with transcript-free reference conditioning · {{device}} · seed {{seed}}. Requested settings are retained; this take records the effective recovery.

outputGain.newHint: 100% preserves the original volume; +50% = 150%, +75% = 175%. Adjustable after generation. Peaks are limited.
outputGain.takeHint: Reversible for audition, mix and export. The original WAV, other takes and local edits are preserved.

sourceAsr.title: Check original text with transcription
sourceAsr.hint: Transcribe this dialogue in its original language and compare the proposal with the source SRT. No translation or changes without your acceptance.
sourceAsr.modelHint: Whisper small multilingual Q5_1 · local CPU · 181 MiB on first use, shared with reference transcription. Up to 16 subtitles and 120 seconds per dialogue.
sourceAsr.noSpeech: No usable speech detected in this slot. Original text retained; check by listening.
sourceAsr.stale: The source text, time slots or audio have changed. Transcribe again before applying.
sourceAsr.applyHint: Review and correct the proposal before applying. Only original SRT text changes; timing, translations and all takes are preserved. Affected translations will need review.
sourceAsr.applied: Original text updated. You can undo this change.

workbench.sharedVoiceText: Shared with “Voice text” in Pronunciation. Editing this field does not change the translated subtitle.
workbench.referenceExcerpt: Excerpt from the chosen track, limited to the first 20 seconds of this dialogue.

pipeline.hint: Creates a raw TTS take, then a separate ChatterboxVC take. Each stage retains its WAV and all earlier takes. Engines load in sequence.
pipeline.guideHint: 0% retains the French TTS delivery. Higher values apply source pitch, rhythm and energy contours before conversion; this does not guarantee faithful acting and may reduce naturalness.

toolbox.title: Audio toolbox · selection
toolbox.hint: Process 0.1 to 60 seconds of the chosen track. Audition outputs, then choose which to place on Speech, Music or Effects. The video and source files remain intact.
toolbox.rangeHint: 0.1–60 second selection at the same timestamp.
toolbox.promptHint: Describe a sound, preferably in English (e.g. footsteps, a man speaking). This describes audio; it does not execute commands.
toolbox.memoryHint: Short windows reduce memory use. Performance and quality depend on model and content; 4 seconds is a starting point for 16 GB VRAM.
toolbox.disk: Free space recommended for installation or repair: {{required}} · available: {{available}}
toolbox.demucsHint: Demucs separates vocals, drums, bass and other. It does not reliably distinguish music from sound effects. Audition before mapping outputs.
toolbox.uniqueDestination: Choose a different destination for each output to apply.
toolbox.muteSource: Mute this section of the source track
toolbox.applyHint: Only chosen destinations are replaced in this interval, using undoable layers. The source track still plays unless muted. Ctrl+Z undoes the application.
toolbox.stale: The source changed after analysis. Run separation again before applying.
